<MethodEndpoint

>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The request body is the build context as a tar archive (optionally gzip-compressed).
`nyx build` creates it from a directory, honouring `.dockerignore`.

The response streams `application/x-ndjson`: `{"stream": "..."}` lines with step
headers and RUN output, then either `{"done": true, "image_id": "sha256:...", "tags": [...]}`
or `{"error": "..."}`. A client disconnect cancels the build.

RUN steps execute in the container sandbox (same seccomp, capabilities, and user
namespace when rootless) with the host network. See docs/build.md.
